subject.title: WebChat: a config-change gateway restart drops the in-flight turn (empty/failed session, recovery can't resume, no user notice)

question: Should this issue be resolved by the scoped WebChat unresumable-notice transcript fallback in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95154, or should closure wait for broader restart deferral or immediate user-message persistence?
rationale: The issue's observable failure includes both lost in-flight state and no user notice; the open PR fixes the notice/blank-chat branch but intentionally does not preserve or finish the interrupted turn.

options.title: Land Scoped Notice Fix
options.body: Accept the current PR as the issue-closing fix for the visible blank WebChat recovery failure, with broader turn-preservation work tracked separately if desired.

options.title: Require Turn Preservation
options.body: Keep this issue open until restart deferral or immediate user-message persistence prevents the interrupted request from being lost, not only noticed.

options.title: Split The Scope
options.body: Land the notice PR but leave or open a narrower follow-up for restart-deferral and durable inbound-message persistence before closing the broader cluster.

recommendation.title: Land Scoped Notice Fix
recommendation.body: Accept the current PR as the issue-closing fix for the visible blank WebChat recovery failure, with broader turn-preservation work tracked separately if desired.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the prior notice and restart-session recovery changes and is the clearest history-backed owner for the product-scope choice.
